            @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(2 - (n - 1), -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_br_cg1d2_b_9!(Ap, Ap_stack, Apb, k, n)
        end
    end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_br_cg1d2_b_10!(Apb, b, bb, n, pb, rb, rsb, xb)
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            rsb[1] = 0.0
        end
    return tol2b
end

function br_cg1d2_cuda(b, x, r, p, Ap, rs, s, t, n, maxit, tol2)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            rs[1] = 0.0
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_br_cg1d2_1!(Ap, b, n, p, r, rs, x)
    for k = 1:maxit
        if CUDA.@allowscalar(rs[1] > tol2)
            @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div((n - 1) - 2, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_br_cg1d2_2!(Ap, n, p)
            CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                    s[1] = 0.0
                end
            if div(n - 1, 1) + 1 < 32768
                @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_br_cg1d2_3!(Ap, n, p, s)
            else
                @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = min(max(1, Base.cld(div(n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)), 1024) cuda_kernel_br_cg1d2_4!(Ap, n, p, s)
            end
            CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                    alpha = rs[1] / s[1]
                    t[1] = 0.0
                end
            @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_br_cg1d2_5!(Ap, alpha, n, p, r, t, x)
            CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                    beta = t[1] / rs[1]
                end
            @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_br_cg1d2_6!(beta, n, p, r)
            CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                    rs[1] = t[1]
                end
        end
    end
    return nothing
end

left() = 700.0 - (time() - T0)
function setup(M, n, bvec)
    T = CuArray
    b = T(bvec); bb = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
    x = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); r = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); p = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); Ap = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
    rs = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1); s = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1); t = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1)
    return (b, x, r, p, Ap, rs, s, t, bb)
end
function run_adj(M, n, maxit, bvec, w)
    (b, x, r, p, Ap, rs, s, t, bb) = setup(M, n, bvec)
    xb = CuArray(w); rb = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); pb = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n); Apb = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
    rsb = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1); sb = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1); tb = CUDA.zeros(Float64, 1)
    st = M.initstacks_br_cg1d2_b_cuda(maxit, n)
    CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time_ns()
    CUDA.@sync M.br_cg1d2_b_cuda(b, bb, x, xb, r, rb, p, pb, Ap, Apb, rs, rsb, s, sb, t, tb, n, maxit, 1.0e-300, 0.0, st...)
    dt = (time_ns() - t0) / 1e6
    bytes = sum(sizeof(a) for a in st)
    return (Array(bb), Array(x), dt, bytes)
end
function run_primal(M, n, maxit, bvec)
    (b, x, r, p, Ap, rs, s, t, bb) = setup(M, n, bvec)
    CUDA.synchronize(); t0 = time_ns()
    CUDA.@sync M.br_cg1d2_cuda(b, x, r, p, Ap, rs, s, t, n, maxit, 1.0e-300)
    return (Array(x), (time_ns() - t0) / 1e6)
end

# correctness at n = 600: directional finite difference of w.x against <bb, d>, and v0.5.17 against v0.5.16
let n = 600, maxit = 20
    bvec = [1.0 + 0.5 * sin(0.01 * i) for i in 1:n]
    w = [cos(0.37 * i) for i in 1:n]; d = [sin(0.91 * i + 0.3) for i in 1:n]
    out = Dict{String,Any}()
    g = Dict{String,Any}()
    for (nm, M) in (("v0516", M16), ("v0517", M17))
        (bb, x, dt, bytes) = run_adj(M, n, maxit, bvec, w)
        h = 1.0e-6
        xp, _ = run_primal(M, n, maxit, bvec .+ h .* d); xm, _ = run_primal(M, n, maxit, bvec .- h .* d)
        fd = sum(w .* (xp .- xm)) / (2h)
        ad = sum(bb .* d)
        out[nm] = Dict("fd" => fd, "adjoint_dot" => ad, "rel_err" => abs(fd - ad) / max(abs(fd), 1e-300))
        g[nm] = bb
    end
    out["max_abs_diff_bb_v0517_vs_v0516"] = maximum(abs.(g["v0517"] .- g["v0516"]))
    out["max_abs_bb"] = maximum(abs.(g["v0516"]))
    res["correctness"] = out
end
# timing: adjoint. The v0.5.16 host loops are slow, so a wall-clock budget decides which runs happen; the result always prints.
let maxit = 10
    rows = Any[]
    last = Dict("v0516" => (500, 0.0), "v0517" => (500, 0.0))
    for n in (500, 2000, 8000)
        bvec = [1.0 + 0.5 * sin(0.01 * i) for i in 1:n]; w = [cos(0.37 * i) for i in 1:n]
        row = Dict{String,Any}("n" => n, "maxit" => maxit)
        for (nm, M) in (("v0516", M16), ("v0517", M17))
            (n0, t0) = last[nm]
            est = t0 * (n / n0) * 1.3 / 1000   # seconds for one run, host loops scale with n
            if left() < 2 * est + 60
                row[nm] = Dict("skipped" => "time budget", "estimate_s" => est)
                continue
            end
            run_adj(M, 100, 2, bvec[1:100], w[1:100])   # compile
            ts = Float64[]; bytes = 0
            for rep in 1:2
                (_, _, dt, bytes) = run_adj(M, n, maxit, bvec, w); push!(ts, dt)
                last[nm] = (n, minimum(ts))
                left() < 3 * dt / 1000 + 60 && break
            end
            row[nm] = Dict("adjoint_ms_min" => minimum(ts), "reps" => length(ts), "stack_bytes" => bytes)
            println(stderr, "n=$n $nm adjoint ms $(minimum(ts)) left $(left())")
        end
        if left() > 30
            pt = [run_primal(M17, n, maxit, bvec)[2] for _ in 1:3]
            row["primal_ms_min"] = minimum(pt[2:end])
        end
        push!(rows, row)
    end
    res["timing"] = rows
end
